purpose: inventory every stored eigenvalue for every frozen Figure 8 case and all three already-computed finite-difference Jacobian step sizes without selecting a mode or constructing a scalar coordinate

mode_matching.method: exhaustive minimum-total-complex-distance assignment over all 6! permutations
mode_matching.tie_break: lexicographically smallest permutation among exactly equal total costs
mode_matching.purpose: descriptive numerical step-size correspondence only; assignment is not a biological mode-selection rule

reported_quantities: all six complex eigenvalues at every step multiplier
all-mode assignment from multiplier 1.0 to 0.5 and 0.25
per-mode absolute and relative complex spread across step multipliers
count of eigenvalues whose stored imaginary component is exactly zero and count whose stored imaginary component is nonzero
spectral abscissa at every step multiplier
whether spectral-abscissa sign is invariant across the three already-computed steps
counting_rule: real/nonreal counts use the exact stored JSON imaginary component, with no newly introduced numerical threshold
spread_rule: absolute spread is the maximum matched complex distance from the multiplier-1.0 reference; relative spread is absolute spread divided by the absolute value of the reference eigenvalue when nonzero, otherwise null
next_gate_after_inventory: Use the complete modal inventory only to design and freeze an explicit representation/identifiability sensitivity test before any scalar reduction. If no non-arbitrary same-mode scalar construction survives that future gate, refuse chi_bio for this system.
